messages:
anika: Quick thread  starting proposal for a 'Optimize playbook' pilot: combine lightweight advisor recommendations (batching/caching/quant) + eval-triggered alerts + a runbook for safe rollouts. Goal: pilot with two customers, measure cost/loss tradeoffs, and produce a one-click rollback UX.
rohan: sounds good. propose we scope the pilot to two tenant profiles: latency-sensitive and cost-sensitive. that will keep knobs small.
maya: +1. for reporting we need per-tenant: cost_delta_estimate, p50/p95 latency change, quality_regression_rate, and alert_count. exportable CSV for customer review.
dinesh: on evals: prefer stewarded prompt sets + population drift detectors. example rule: "mean BLEU on stewarded set drops > 3% over 12h -> fire alert". also recommend adding a human review step before automated rollback.
lina: customer ask from Playwell: show "why" for each suggestion (tokens saved, expected latency impact, fallback plan). they want a diff view and a revert button in console.
anika: MVP proposal: advisor API (recommendations + confidence score), alerts service (webhook + console notice), and console card with accept/revert. no model surgery in first iteration.
maya: telemetry retention for pilot = 45d. ops wants a synthetic dry-run mode so customers can preview recommendations on sampled traffic without applying.
rohan: dry-run = great. engineering spike: simulate 48h of requests and estimate: tokens_before, tokens_after_est, avg_latency_before, avg_latency_after_est. we should estimate cost in $ as well.
dinesh: for quant recommendations use shadow-inference on a small sample and compute divergence metrics (e.g., response perplexity delta, top-k overlap). threshold to recommend int8 only if top-k overlap > 0.92 and perplexity delta < 0.05.
lina: pilot acceptance criteria (draft): 1) median cost improvement >= 8% on cost-sensitive tenant, 2) p95 latency increase <= 30ms on latency-sensitive tenant, 3) false alert rate <= 4% on stewarded sets, 4) revert path validated in runbook.
anika: ops constraints: need infra quota for replay runs and a small staging pool to run shadow quant checks. flagging infra-team.
rohan: initial batching policy for latency-first profile:
```json
{
  "profile": "latency-first",
  "max_batch": 16,
  "max_wait_ms": 25,
  "enable_adaptive_batching": true
}
```
rohan: caching suggestion: enable prefix KV for hotspot prompts with ttl 60s, sample-size threshold 100 calls/min.
maya: UX asks: show confidence band on cost estimates (+/- %), and allow customers to set safety knobs (max_cost_increase, min_quality_threshold).
dinesh: alert remediation suggestions should include two options: soft rollback (switch to previous quant config) and safe mode (disable quant + force small batch). include suggested comms text for CS.
lina: I'll draft the pilot signoff template for customers: includes baseline capture steps, evaluation window, acceptance thresholds, emergency contact. will share by Tue.
anika: action list: 1) anika - finalize scope + launch checklist PR by Tue EOD, 2) rohan - engineering spike + replay harness by Fri, 3) dinesh - shadow quant POC + divergence metrics by Fri, 4) maya - telemetry + UX mocks for diff + revert by Mon, 5) lina - pilot signoff template by Tue.
ops-bot: infra-bot: reminder  request dedicated replay quota via #eng-infra with tag OPT-PILOT-2111.
rohan: blockers: need signed pilot NDAs for AcmeHealth and Playwell, and infra quota.
anika: if everyone can ack we lock scope and I'll open the spec PR. please react with :white_check_mark: to acknowledge.
rohan: ack :white_check_mark:
maya: ack :white_check_mark:
dinesh: ack :white_check_mark:
lina: ack :white_check_mark:
